_comment: Project-scoped MCP servers for Claude Code. Any Claude Code session opened
in this repo (local CLI, web, desktop) picks these up automatically.
firecrawl: gives the agent web search + scraping tools (firecrawl_search,
firecrawl_scrape, firecrawl_crawl, ...). The API key is NOT stored here.
${FIRECRAWL_API_KEY} is expanded from the environment at startup:
- locally:  put FIRECRAWL_API_KEY=... in your shell or a .env file
- on the web: add it as an environment variable in the cloud
environment settings (title bar menu -> Edit environment).
Prefer OAuth instead of a key? Swap the url for
https://mcp.firecrawl.dev/v2/mcp-oauth and run `claude mcp login firecrawl`.
